_comment: Reviewed complexity acceptances, companion to complexity_baseline.json. The baseline is generated wholesale by --write-baseline and has nowhere to say WHY a row is tolerated; this file is the half a human looked at. Every entry pins the score it was accepted AT, so a row that grows further is measured against the reviewed value and fails again, and every entry states its reason (aeat-quality-gates: allowlists are where the judgement moves, so each entry states its reason and stale entries must be visible). Hand-maintained on purpose: unlike the baseline this is NEVER regenerated from the current tree, because regenerating it would be exactly the silent grandfathering it exists to prevent. A row whose score ROSE is not accepted here on structural grounds alone -- it is a separate, explicit decision whose reason must say that it grew.
